adminExistingMembershipHint: Staff already assigned to this branch are not listed here. Use Edit in the list to update or reactivate their membership.
adminIntro: Manage branches, registers and staff access in the current store.
adminScopeNote: Changes apply only to this store. Orders and transaction history are preserved.
adminHint_branches: Link stock locations, configure receiving locations and set each branch's timezone.
adminHint_registers: Manage registers by branch. Branches without registers can still sell.
adminHint_memberships: Search by name or email and edit each employee's permissions at each branch.
adminAccessDenied: This account cannot view or manage POS configuration in this store. Return to selling to use your assigned permissions.
adminOptionsError: Some configuration data could not be loaded. Creating and editing are locked to prevent incorrect saves. Please retry.
adminEmptyHint: Try another filter or add a configuration using the button above.
adminConfirmDisable: Deactivate “{{name}}”? Related new operations will be locked. History and transactions will not be deleted.
adminConfirmEnable: Reactivate “{{name}}”? This action will be recorded in the administration audit log.
adminRecoveryRequired: Branch recovery permission is required to reactivate
adminCodeHint: Lowercase a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores; up to 32 characters.
adminRegisterNote: A new register does not open a shift or transfer an active sale. Existing registers keep their branch to preserve history.
adminFindStaff: Find staff by name or email
adminPermissionBoundary: These are branch-level POS capabilities, not store API roles. Grant only necessary permissions; no store administration roles are automatically granted.
adminConfirmPermissions: I confirm I have checked sensitive permission changes for the correct staff member and branch.
adminDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Close and discard these changes?
capabilityShiftHint: Open a shift and perform sales operations within assigned store roles.
capabilityDiscountHint: Edit item discounts and whole-invoice discounts.
capabilityPriceHint: Change item selling prices; a sensitive capability that requires oversight.
capabilityCustomerHint: Create and update customer information at the POS.
capabilityPaymentHint: Collect payments at the register. Does not include resolving discrepancies.
capabilityPaymentResolveHint: Reconcile and resolve money requiring review, separate from collecting payments.
capabilityApproveHint: Approve actions that require supervisor authorization in the correct scope.
capabilityTakeoverHint: Explicitly take over editing when another editor holds the workspace.
capabilityManageHint: Branch POS management capability; configuration pages still require store administration roles.
capabilityRecoverHint: Reactivate disabled branches, registers or staff memberships.
itemDiscountHint: Whole-line amount or percentage. Replaces the item promotion without double counting. Invoice discounts remain separate.
linePriceHint: Enter whole VND without separators. You can increase or decrease the unit price for this line without affecting item discounts.
developmentNotice: POS IN DEVELOPMENT · Selling, inventory and payments are not enabled
selectSalesContextHint: Choose a branch to begin. Choose a register only if the branch has multiple registers.
loginHelp: Need access? Ask your store manager to provision a staff account.
settingsHint: Manage branches, registers and staff access. Changes take effect only after server confirmation.
registerHint: Create a register in the correct branch. Choose the active register from the header.
membershipHint: Staff permissions are granted separately for each branch.
staffEmpty: No staff access has been granted yet.
pageChooseBranchHint: Open the branch / register picker in the header to view records.
fundsPageHint: Up to 25 records per page. Attention filtering applies to the current page.
fundsEmpty: No received funds on this page.
fundsSelectHint: Allocation details and permitted actions will appear here.
fundsReadOnly: Read only. Resolving payments permission is required to issue payouts.
catalogTryAgain: Try another name, SKU or barcode.
basketReady: Choose a product above to add it to this order.
cancelDraftConfirm: Cancel draft {{order}}? Check its items and received funds before continuing.
cancelDraftPayments: This draft has recorded payments. Resolve or reverse them before canceling.
customerOptional: Optional · Select to find a customer
paymentAddItems: Add items to the order before taking payment.
paymentPrepareHint: Next: review and confirm the funds received.
customerSearch: Search by name, phone or email
customerEmailHint: Email may be left blank. If it matches a store account, the original customer is linked; no fake email is created.
customerCreateDenied: You do not have permission to quick-create customers.
customerDuplicateWarning: This phone already has another profile. The system does not merge automatically; verify before attaching.
discountApprovalHint: Requires an approval bound to this draft, amount and revision. Price overrides remain separately locked.
discountFailed: Could not apply the discount. Check permission, approval and the current total, then try again.
couponFailed: Voucher code is invalid, expired, or not eligible for this order.
notePlaceholder: For example: customer collects later, pack separately…
noteHint: This note is stored only on the POS draft; it is not copied to the core order or printed yet.
noteFailed: Could not save the note. Check edit permission, reload the draft and try again.
totalsUnavailable: Pricing and totals are not connected yet.
paymentUnavailable: Payments and transactions are not available yet.
recoveryChecked: Verified {{count}} operations recorded by the server.
recoveryMissing: No server result was found for {{count}} operations (404). This does not prove they failed. For editing access, return to the same invoice and select “Claim editing”; finish editing on the other device first if necessary. Do not create a replacement order or payment.
recoveryBlocked: Cannot look up {{count}} operations because of session or access restrictions. Recovery evidence is retained. Ask a manager to check access before continuing.
recoveryFailed: Could not check {{count}} operations because of a network or server error. Recovery evidence is retained. Check the connection and try again.
catalogAdvanced: Add by quantity, lot or sales unit
catalogSearchPrompt: Search by name, SKU or barcode for products at this branch.
catalogEmpty: No products assigned to this branch matched.
catalogReadOnly: On-hand stock is not guaranteed available. Prices are store list prices before counter discounts.
basketEmpty: No items in this draft yet.
basketStart: Create or select an order, then search for products to add.
checkoutChooseDraft: Select an order to find or assign a customer.
checkoutNoTotals: Totals will appear for the selected order.
checkoutNoPayment: Select an order to view available payment methods.
shiftNotOpen: No shift is open at this register.
workspaceChooseContext: Select a branch and register to begin.
workspaceNeedShift: An open shift owned by you is required to create an order.
workspaceCurrencyChanged: This shift was opened in {{currency}}, but the store now uses {{current}}. Choose a register with a {{current}} shift and create a new order; existing orders keep their currency.
workspaceShiftOwned: The current shift belongs to another staff member; you cannot create an order in it.
productsUnavailable: Product selection will be enabled after pricing and inventory are verified.
saleLineMerge: Merge into an identical existing package
saleLineDraftOnly: Draft lot/serial selection only; stock is not guaranteed and tracked goods cannot be tendered yet.
saleLineInvalidQuantity: Quantity must be an exact decimal, for example 1.25.
saleLineAddFailed: Could not add the line. Check the unit, quantity and edit permission, then try again.
saleLineCommandFailed: Could not run the line action. Check permission, approval and reload the draft, then try again.
scanQueued: Scan queued; ambiguous results need a manual choice, never a guess.
title: Selling workspace
intro: Sign in with a Spree staff account to begin.
failure: Could not sign in or load the staff profile. Check the account and connection, then try again.
logoutFailure: This screen is locked, but the server session was not confirmed revoked. Check the connection and revoke it from admin.
placeholder: The selling area is still being built.
notice: Creating orders, checking stock, and taking payment are not available here.
security: The session lives only in browser memory.
branchMissing: Store and register are not connected yet.
capabilitiesEmpty: Selling, stock, and payment capabilities are not granted.
connectionOffline: Connection lost. Writes are locked on this screen.
unauthorized: The session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
forbidden: This account is not allowed to use POS for the current store.
invalid: The submitted data is not valid.
missing: That branch or register was not found in this store.
conflict: The record changed. Reload it and try again.
leaseBusy: This invoice is held by another tab, device, or the page before reload. Do not reload again. Close the other editor and wait for the lease to expire (up to 2 minutes), or explicitly use “Take over editing” if permitted and needed.
leaseStale: This page's editing access expired or was taken over elsewhere. Select “Claim editing” again; reloading is not required.
leaseRetryIn: Try claiming again in {{seconds}} seconds. Another active editor may renew the lease.
leaseRetryReady: The wait is over. Select “Claim editing” to check with the server again.
leaseExplanation: Only one tab or device can hold editing access to an invoice at a time, to prevent conflicting changes. Reloading the page or reopening an invoice may require claiming editing again. This message does not mean your account permissions were removed.
leaseInstruction: Select “Claim editing” to continue. If another tab or device holds editing access, finish there first; use “Take over editing” only when needed and permitted.
leaseLost: Editing access expired or could not be confirmed. Claim it again.
handoverUnavailable: Moving a draft to another register is not available.
selectionRestored: The branch did not change. The previous choice stays.
unsent: A command is pending or its outcome is unknown. Signing out removes this tab's recovery keys but does not delete server drafts. Continue?
uncertainWarning: A command's outcome is unknown. Do not create another draft; retry the same action to check its result with the server.
moreDrafts: Choose another draft on this page
writesLocked: The branch or staff access is disabled. The open shift and existing drafts stay. New shifts and draft changes are locked.
linesLater: Item lines stay disconnected until price and stock proofs are accepted.
paymentEvidenceRequired: Bank transfer needs a reference and receiving account; cash needs the handed amount.
financialUncertainWarning: A payment on this browser is not yet confirmed by the server. Do not create a new tender; check server status or reconcile manually.
fundsHint: Each real receipt has one parent record. Money not applied to an order remains a liability until allocated or paid out with evidence.
fundsAllocateHint: Allocation to an order is done from that workspace payment panel after reloading unapplied server balances.
fundsManualReconcile: If browser data was cleared, the device was lost, or storage failed: keep evidence and reconcile manually with the server; do not create a new tender.
fundsAttentionHint: Money arrived but is not fully applied or not yet resolved. It never completes an order or hands goods over by itself.
fundsAttentionEmpty: No payment needs attention at the selected branch.
paymentAllocate: Apply unapplied funds to this order
financialStorageUnavailable: The payment intent could not be saved in this browser. Do not continue collecting; check storage and retry.
editLockedPayments: This draft has recorded payments, so items, quantities, prices, discounts, customer and note can no longer be changed.
scanAmbiguous: Code {{code}} matches several items. Nothing was added; choose the right item from the results.
scanNotFound: No item has the exact barcode or SKU {{code}}. Nothing was added.
scanNoPrice: The item with code {{code}} has no price and was not added.
scanUnknown: The result of scanning {{code}} is unknown ({{count}} scans waiting). Check the connection and select “Retry scan”; the same scan is resent, so nothing is added twice.
saleLineInvalidCount: Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 10000.
discountInvalidPercent: The discount percentage must be a number from 0 to 100.
discountInvalidFlat: The discount amount must be a whole number of dong.
scanLabelRejected: Scale label {{code}} was refused: {{reason}} Nothing was added.
scanLabelUnreadable: the server returned label data that could not be read.
branchProductsIntro: Choose which store products this branch sells and set their units and scale label codes.
labelFormatsIntro: How the EAN-13 codes printed by this branch's scales are read.
branchProductsHint: Add or remove products; only products sold here appear at this branch's registers.
branchProductsReadOnly: You can only view this list.
branchProductsEmpty: No products match the search and filter.
variantUnitNoVariants: No SKU of this product was found in the branch catalog.
variantUnitSwitchHint: Save or cancel your changes before choosing another SKU.
variantUnitLoadFailed: Could not load the unit configuration: {{reason}}
variantUnitNotSold: the SKU is not sold at this branch, or you have no access at this branch.
variantUnitBaseHint: Follows the sale unit: g for kg, ml for litre, chai for pack and case.
variantUnitRatioInvalid: Conversion ratios must be whole numbers from 1 to 1,000,000.
variantUnitLabelCodeHint: Up to 8 digits, matching the item code printed on the label (including leading zeros). Leave blank when the SKU is not sold by scale label.
variantUnitLabelCodeInvalid: The label code is up to 8 digits only.
variantUnitLockNote: Once the SKU has sale lines only the label code can change; unit or ratio changes are refused.
labelFormatsHint: Each format describes an EAN-13 code: prefix, item code, value (weight or price) and check digit.
labelFormatsEmptyHint: Without a format every scanned code at this branch is looked up as an ordinary barcode.
labelFormatSummary: Prefix {{prefix}} · item code {{item}} digits · value {{value}} digits
labelFormatConfirmDisable: Disable label format “{{name}}”? Labels printed with it will no longer be read as scale labels. Sales history is kept.
labelFormatLayoutUnknown: Enter the prefix and lengths to check they fill {{total}} digits.
labelFormatLayoutInvalid: Using {{used}}/{{total}} digits. Prefix, item code and value must fill exactly {{total}} digits.
labelFormatLayoutValid: All {{used}}/{{total}} digits used; the 13th digit is the check digit.
labelFormatToleranceHint: Largest difference allowed between the printed price and the price the server recalculates.
labelFormatVersionNote: Each saved change increases the version; sold lines keep the version they were read with.
labelFormatProblem_name: Enter a format name of up to 80 characters.
labelFormatProblem_itemCodeLength: Item code digits must be a positive whole number.
labelFormatProblem_valueLength: Value digits must be a positive whole number.
labelFormatProblem_layout: Prefix + item code + value must equal exactly {{total}} digits.
labelFormatProblem_unit: A weight label needs the unit g, kg, ml or l.
labelFormatProblem_tolerance: The price difference must be a non-negative number.
saleLineLabelLocked: A scale label keeps its quantity; remove the line to weigh again.
paymentBankCaption: Check the bank statement or app, then enter the actual transaction reference and receiving account.
paymentReceivedHint: Leave empty when exactly this tender amount arrived. Any excess is kept as unapplied funds.
paymentReceivedInvalid: The received amount must be whole VND and not less than this tender.
paymentAmountInvalid: Invalid amount. Enter whole VND; thousands may be grouped with dots (e.g. 150.000).
paymentZeroTotalApproval: A 0 ₫ order needs approval rights to complete. Ask a manager to complete it.
paymentHeldHint: This order has tenders waiting for confirmation.
paymentCancelConfirm: Cancel {{count}} pending tenders? Only cancel when the customer will not pay with them.
financialStorageWarning: This browser cannot keep unresolved payment records. Reconcile manually with the funds ledger before collecting again; do not create new tenders.
recoveryNotCommitted: {{count}} payment commands were never recorded by the server and were removed from the pending list. Collect again if the customer has not paid.
localRecordsHint: Payment commands that were sent without a known result. Check them from the warning bar; mark one reconciled only after a manual check.
localRecordConfirm: Checked this manually against the ledger or bank? The record will be removed from this browser.
